records.title: Use a SQLite-backed serial campaign coordinator
Allow unrestricted campaign auto-merge after evidence gates

research.sqliteTransactions: Use synchronous better-sqlite3 transactions with BEGIN IMMEDIATE for compare-and-set mutations and automatic rollback on exceptions.
research.partialIndexes: Use SQLite unique partial indexes to enforce one active campaign per repository/base branch and one active cycle per campaign.
research.conflictHandling: Use SQLite ABORT semantics and translate constraint failures to typed campaign conflicts; do not use REPLACE.

web.reason: This prerequisite increment has no HTTP or portal surface.

research.effectivePricingLookup: Resolve pricing synchronously at campaign creation and immediately before model turns using the price effective at the check time.
research.transactionPattern: Use better-sqlite3 transaction.immediate() so pricing validation and campaign creation are one atomic write decision.
research.waitStatePattern: Persist a pricing-specific waiting_for_external marker and restore only the same cycle's prior runnable status.
research.unknownPricePolicy: Reject autonomous campaign models without pricing while preserving manual-task unpriced usage reporting.

web.reason: Campaign portal model selectors are scoped to ext-001.

research.authorizationPattern: Mount router-level ADMIN middleware across the complete campaign control surface.
research.repositoryValidation: Use the GitHub branch endpoint with configured credentials before campaign persistence.
research.socketPattern: Broadcast serializable campaign detail events through the existing Socket.IO server.
research.webPattern: Use a Next.js Client Component for interactive controls, browser authentication, and live Socket.IO refreshes.

failedRuns.failure: Cucumber UI scenario timed out because the CI web client used a cross-origin API URL with credentialed requests instead of the existing same-origin Next.js API proxy.

ci.localValidation: Campaign controls UI scenario passed through the same-origin proxy: 1 scenario, 7 steps.

playwright.failure: The production HTTP/2 response had an empty statusText, so the non-admin portal displayed a generic API error instead of Admin access required.

research.finding: Fetch Response.statusText can be empty for HTTP/2 responses; error classification must use the numeric Response.status.

implementation.behavior: All generic API client failures now include the numeric HTTP status and optional status text.

research.exactShaReads: Resolve the campaign branch once, then read repository trees and file contents by the resulting immutable commit SHA.
research.promptSecurity: Treat repository, GitHub, runtime, and ideation text as untrusted data; redact secret-shaped values and neutralize nested delimiter tokens before persistence.
research.persistence: Store the snapshot JSON beside base_sha on the autonomous cycle in one immediate SQLite transaction with replay-by-cycle idempotency.

research.copilotSdk: The installed @github/copilot-sdk 0.3.0 supports raw JSON Schema custom tools but not response-schema output; use one restricted submission tool per isolated generator or critic session and validate again in-process.

research.fingerprinting: Use Node crypto SHA-256 over canonical JSON after lowercase, trim, whitespace collapse, and lexicographic scope sorting.

research.scheduler: Use recursive unref timers, non-overlapping ticks, round-robin campaign selection, and heartbeat every owned lease.
research.remoteRecovery: Persist deterministic branch, image, preview, and pull-request checkpoints before or immediately after remote mutation, and reuse open PRs by head branch.

research.durabilityPattern: Persist campaign state and remote checkpoints; use idempotent transitions and renewable leases.
research.sdkSessionPolicy: Treat Copilot SDK sessions as ephemeral workers, not durable campaign state.
research.releasePattern: Campaign-marked PRs bypass RM webhook/polling dispatch; success requires explicit merge and base-SHA confirmation.
research.acceptedRisk: No sensitive-path denylist or mandatory human approval; tests and LLM review gate all campaign diffs.
